To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
BPA-PC plastic lens used in light conversion carriers and LED packages can be successfully accelerated by using elevated temperature stress.

(1) the BPA-PC plastic optical lens lifetime is 20,000 h at 100 °C and 1000 h at 140 °C, (2) the BPA grade has a significant effect on the lifetime of the lens, and (3) the optical degradation of the lens can be described by the exponential luminous decay equation.
“The lifetime of BPA- PC plastic lens, used for LED-based products, can be estimated based on the results of accelerated thermal stress tests and an appropriate reliability model”.

the optical properties of the BPA-PC plastic lens, used for encapsulation of LED-based products, and its lifetime prediction.
